policy.exact_identity_requires: An authenticated exact-identity reference measured under a comparable method, or independently validated orthogonal evidence.
policy.notes: Titles, identifiers, applicability and concise evidence-scope summaries are curated. A literature mention is never converted into measured fragment intensities.

sources.title: Mass spectrometry-based metabolomics: a guide for annotation, quantification and best reporting practices
sources.finding: High-resolution mass and MS/MS annotation can remain structurally ambiguous; authenticated standards and orthogonal evidence are needed for the strongest identification claims.

sources.title: Software Tools and Approaches for Compound Identification of LC-MS/MS Data in Metabolomics
sources.finding: Combining independent molecular properties is more informative than treating one spectral-library score as exact structural proof.

sources.title: Product ion mobility as a promising tool for assignment of positional isomers of drug metabolites
sources.finding: Product-ion mobility and collision-cross-section evidence can add positional information when conventional product-ion spectra are insufficient.

sources.title: A mass spectrum-oriented computational method for ion mobility-resolved untargeted metabolomics
sources.finding: Ion mobility adds a gas-phase separation dimension that can reduce unresolved isomer overlap, subject to method and reference comparability.

sources.title: Separation of ephedrine and pseudoephedrine enantiomers using a polysaccharide-based chiral column: A normal phase liquid chromatography-high-resolution mass spectrometry approach
sources.finding: A polysaccharide-based chiral stationary phase in normal-phase LC-HRMS separated ephedrine and pseudoephedrine stereoisomers; mobile-phase and modifier choice materially affected separation.

sources.title: A Buffered LC-MS Method for Resolving and Quantifying Albiflorin and Paeoniflorin
sources.finding: The isomers showed similar mass-spectral behavior and method-dependent chromatographic artifacts; a buffered phenyl-hexyl LC method was developed to resolve and quantify them.

reported_conditions.mobile_phase: 10 mM ammonium acetate adjusted with acetic acid
reported_conditions.warning: Formic-acid conditions can produce an additional albiflorin-related chromatographic peak with similar m/z and fragmentation.
